concepts.title: Land Use Categories and Their Changes
concepts.definition: The land use record divides India's area into forest land, land put to non-agricultural uses, barren and wasteland, permanent pastures, culturable wasteland, current and old fallows and net sown area; the net sown area is the core of the agricultural economy and its share shapes cropping possibilities.
concepts.key_idea: Subtracting the forest percentage of the reporting area from 100 gives the non-forest land share.
concepts.textbook_ref: legy203.txt land use categories and their composition sections

solution_steps.explain: forest land is a stated percentage of the reporting area

concepts.title: Cropping Pattern: Cereals and Pulses
concepts.definition: On the basis of grain structure foodgrains divide into cereals and pulses; cereals occupy about 54 per cent of the total cropped area of India, so the remaining cropped area carries pulses, oilseeds, fibres and other crops.
concepts.key_idea: Subtracting the cereal share of cropped area from 100 gives the share under all non-cereal crops.
concepts.textbook_ref: legy203.txt cereals occupy about 54 per cent of total cropped area

solution_steps.explain: cereals cover about 54 per cent of total cropped area
the rest of cropped area is non-cereal

concepts.title: Land Degradation and Conservation
concepts.definition: Land degradation through water and wind erosion, waterlogging, salinisation and alkalinisation removes the productive base; conservation responses include afforestation, grazing control, contour bunding, terrace farming, shelter belts and regulated use of chemical fertilisers and irrigation.
concepts.key_idea: Degradation is both natural and human-made, so conservation must combine engineering works with farming practice change.
concepts.textbook_ref: legy203.txt degradation causes and conservation measures sections
question_patterns: list the major causes of land degradation in India

solution_steps.explain: erosion, waterlogging, salinity and chemical misuse degrade cropland
contour bunding checks water erosion; shelter belts check wind
grazing control and irrigation discipline sustain the gains

concepts.title: Common Property Resources
concepts.definition: Common property resources are resources accessible to the whole community like village pastures, tanks, forests and ponds; they support the rural poor, but open access without regulation leads to their overuse and decline, so community management is essential.
concepts.key_idea: The tragedy of the commons is reversed where village institutions regulate grazing, fishing and firewood collection.

solution_steps.explain: commons are open to community use, unlike private plots
unregulated use shrinks pastures, tanks and groves
local rules restore the balance between use and renewal
